description: This PHP source file handles various operations related to saving, deleting, and managing relationships between records in the SuiteCRM platform. It processes different request parameters to perform actions such as saving reports, adding prospects, campaign logs, and updating relationships between modules.

classes.name: Unknown
classes.description: This file does not define its own classes but dynamically loads bean classes based on request parameters.

methods.name: save_from_report
methods.description: Saves data from a report and related subpanel, invoked when return_type is 'report'.

methods.name: add_prospects_to_prospect_list
methods.description: Adds specified prospects to a prospect list, invoked when return_type is 'addtoprospectlist'.

methods.name: add_to_prospect_list
methods.description: Adds a record to a prospect list with various link attributes.

methods.name: create_campaign_log_entry
methods.description: Creates a campaign log entry for a given campaign and focus bean.
